reason: This passage describes the battle of Israel against Amalek at Rephidim (Exodus 17:8-16). The text depicts Moses giving clear military instructions to Joshua, followed by coordinated leadership actions (Moses holding up the staff on the hill, Aaron and Hur supporting his arms, Joshua leading the battle). The narrative shows obedience to leadership and military victory, not any complaint about leaders. There is no language of grievance, dissatisfaction, or complaint directed toward Moses, Joshua, Aaron, or any leadership figures.
